instrument: UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018
why_it_might_matter: Health data is special-category data. Need a lawful basis, an Article 9 condition and a data protection impact assessment.
open_question: Are we a processor (operating the tool for the trust) or a controller (developing a product from the data)? Probably both, at different stages.

instrument: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025
why_it_might_matter: Amends UK data protection law, including some rules on automated decisions and on research.
status_as_we_understand_it: Royal Assent June 2025; provisions commencing in stages.
open_question: Which provisions are in force now and do any change our DPIA?

instrument: Common law duty of confidentiality; National Data Opt-out
why_it_might_matter: Patients can opt out of their confidential information being used beyond their own care (planning, research).
status_as_we_understand_it: In force. Applies unless data is truly anonymised or another exemption applies.
open_question: Is our extract in scope, and did the trust apply the opt-out before sending it?

instrument: Data Security and Protection Toolkit
why_it_might_matter: Annual self-assessment for any organisation handling NHS patient data.
status_as_we_understand_it: We hold 'Standards Met' for 2025-26 covering Wardline Live.
open_question: Does Horizon change our scope or evidence?

instrument: Digital Technology Assessment Criteria (DTAC)
why_it_might_matter: Baseline assessment that NHS buyers ask for: clinical safety, data protection, security, interoperability, usability and accessibility.
status_as_we_understand_it: In use; a revised version has been announced. Trusts differ in which form they ask for.
open_question: Which version will Kingsmere require, and by when?

instrument: Clinical risk management standards DCB0129 (supplier) and DCB0160 (deploying organisation)
why_it_might_matter: Requires a Clinical Safety Officer, hazard log and safety case for health IT that could affect patient care.
open_question: No hazard log or safety case exists for Horizon. The trust needs its own DCB0160 work before live use.

instrument: UK Medical Devices Regulations 2002 (as amended); regulator guidance on software and AI as a medical device
why_it_might_matter: If the intended purpose includes informing decisions about individual patients, software may be a medical device.
status_as_we_understand_it: In force; reform programme under way.
open_question: We have no written intended-purpose statement. Operational planning tools are generally outside scope, but our sales material talks about 'who to discharge'.

instrument: Equality Act 2010 and the Public Sector Equality Duty
why_it_might_matter: The trust must consider equality impacts of changes it adopts and will likely ask us for evidence.
open_question: We have done no equality analysis.

instrument: Procurement Act 2023
why_it_might_matter: Rules for how NHS bodies buy; thresholds above which competition is needed.
open_question: At what contract value does a pilot stop being a pilot?

instrument: Freedom of Information Act 2000
why_it_might_matter: Contracts, DPIAs and evaluation reports held by the trust can be requested by anyone.
open_question: Would we be comfortable seeing our DPIA and accuracy figures published?

instrument: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679
why_it_might_matter: As UK GDPR, with national health-data rules on top in each member state.
open_question: Our Dutch subsidiary is the EU establishment. Where is data processed for EU customers?

instrument: Artificial Intelligence Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by the 'Digital Omnibus on AI' (2026)
why_it_might_matter: Risk-based rules for AI systems. Obligations depend on whether a system is 'high-risk'.
status_as_we_understand_it: In force since August 2024. Prohibited practices and AI-literacy duties apply since February 2025. After the 2026 amendment, high-risk obligations apply from 2 December 2027 (stand-alone systems) and 2 August 2028 (AI embedded in regulated products).
open_question: Is a bed-demand forecast high-risk? Not obviously in the listed areas, but it would be if it were a medical device needing third-party assessment, or if used to prioritise individual patients. Needs a legal opinion.

instrument: Medical Device Regulation (EU) 2017/745
why_it_might_matter: Software qualification and classification, as for the UK.
open_question: Same intended-purpose question as in the UK.

instrument: European Health Data Space Regulation (EU) 2025/327
why_it_might_matter: Rules for re-use of health data for research, innovation and policy.
status_as_we_understand_it: In force since 2025; most provisions apply in later years.
open_question: Does it create a route to data, or new duties, for us?

instrument: National requirements (for example Dutch NEN 7510 information security standard; staff-council co-determination in Germany)
why_it_might_matter: Hosting, security certification, and consultation with staff representatives where a system affects rostering or can monitor work.
open_question: Raised by Dutch and German prospects; not costed.

instrument: Data Protection Act, 2019 and its regulations
why_it_might_matter: Health data is sensitive personal data. Controllers and processors register with the data protection regulator. Conditions apply to transfers out of Kenya.
open_question: Can hospital data be processed in the UK or EU? Do we or our partner need to register?

instrument: Digital Health Act, 2023
why_it_might_matter: Governs health information systems and health data; creates a national digital health agency.
status_as_we_understand_it: In force; implementing arrangements still developing.
open_question: Does a forecasting tool need approval or certification? Are there data-location rules for health data?

instrument: Devolved health system; Social Health Authority
why_it_might_matter: County governments run county hospitals; the national insurer reimburses them.
status_as_we_understand_it: Reimbursements to hospitals have been slow.
open_question: Who can sign, and who can pay?

instrument: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection
why_it_might_matter: Health data is 'specific' personal data. Rules on consent, impact assessment and cross-border transfer.
open_question: Status of implementing regulations and the supervisory agency; conditions for processing outside Indonesia.

instrument: Law No. 17 of 2023 on Health and its implementing regulation; Minister of Health Regulation No. 24 of 2022 on Medical Records
why_it_might_matter: Electronic medical records are mandatory and must connect to the national health data platform (SATUSEHAT).
open_question: Where must medical-record data be stored? Is a nightly extract to a foreign cloud permitted?

instrument: Government Regulation No. 71 of 2019 on electronic systems and transactions
why_it_might_matter: Rules for electronic system operators, including where public-sector data is held.
open_question: Is a regional public hospital's data 'public-sector' data for this purpose?

instrument: Presidential Regulation No. 59 of 2024 (national health insurance; standard inpatient class, 'KRIS')
why_it_might_matter: Changes how many beds a room may hold and so how many beds a hospital has.
status_as_we_understand_it: Phased implementation; deadlines have moved more than once.
open_question: More reconfiguration to come? It changes the capacity our forecast is compared against.

instrument: Public procurement rules and e-catalogue
why_it_might_matter: Public hospitals usually buy through the government e-catalogue from locally registered suppliers.
open_question: Do we need a local entity or a reseller?

instrument: ISO/IEC 27001 (information security); ISO 13485 (medical device quality); ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management)
why_it_might_matter: Buyers ask for certificates.
status_as_we_understand_it: We are certified to ISO/IEC 27001. We do not hold ISO 13485 or ISO/IEC 42001.
open_question: Which will buyers insist on?

instrument: World Health Organization guidance on ethics and governance of AI for health (2021)
why_it_might_matter: Non-binding principles: human autonomy, safety, transparency, accountability, inclusiveness, sustainability.
open_question: Used by donors (including the Kenyan foundation) as a funding condition.
